in_sanskrit.name: नवन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: नव (nav) means new or fresh, and न् (n) is a suffix that denotes continuity or perpetuity. So Navansh in Sanskrit means 'new and continuous' or 'fresh and perpetual'.

in_hindi.name: नवन्श
in_hindi.meaning: नव (nav) means new or fresh, and श (sh) is a suffix that denotes existence or being. So Navansh in Hindi means 'new being' or 'fresh existence'.

in_tamil.name: நவன்ச
in_tamil.long_meaning: நவ (navan) means new or fresh in Tamil, so Navansh in Tamil means 'new and fresh'.

in_telugu.name: నవన్శ
in_telugu.long_meaning: నవ (navan) means new or fresh in Telugu, so Navansh in Telugu means 'new and fresh'.

in_marathi.name: Navansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे New Life, Birth of New Era
in_marathi.long_meaning: Navansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Navansh is a name derived from Sanskrit roots meaning 'new' (nav) and 'life' (ansh). This name symbolizes the beginning of a new life, a new era, or a new cycle. In Hindu mythology, Navansh is associated with the god Brahma, the creator of the universe, representing the endless cycle of birth, life, and death.
